decks.notes: This deck focuses on quickly casting powerful cascade spells like Crashing Footfalls and Violent Outburst to overwhelm the opponent with multiple threats. By utilizing cards like Shardless Agent and Bonecrusher Giant along with aggressive creatures like Brazen Borrower, the deck aims to maintain a steady stream of pressure while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Force of Negation and Dead/Gone. The land base is carefully constructed to support the deck's mana requirements and ensure consistent casting of spells.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on using efficient aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief to put pressure on the opponent quickly. It also incorporates disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Terminate to control the opponent's game plan. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Undying Evil and Feign Death to protect your key threats and bring them back from the graveyard. By combining aggression with disruption, this deck aims to establish board control and close out the game before the opponent has a chance to stabilize.

The deck revolves around utilizing artifacts to control the game while generating value through combos like Thopter Foundry and Sword of the Meek. Urza, Lord High Artificer provides mana advantage and powerful abilities, while Emry, Lurker of the Loch helps recur artifacts from the graveyard. Stoneforge Mystic fetches key equipment pieces like Shadowspear and Kaldra Compleat to enhance the control elements. Esper Sentinel provides disruptive elements and Mishra's Bauble offers card advantage. The deck aims to outvalue opponents while controlling the board with a mix of counterspells, removal, and efficient threats.

This deck focuses on using efficient spells and creatures to apply pressure on the opponent quickly. It uses cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent to attack aggressively while disrupting the opponent with counterspells like Archmage's Charm and Spell Pierce. The deck also has card draw and selection with spells like Consider and Expressive Iteration to ensure it maintains momentum. The mana base is designed to support the deck's two colors, allowing for consistent casting of spells throughout the game.

The main concept of the deck is to utilize reanimation cards like Persist and Indomitable Creativity to bring out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty onto the battlefield quickly. This is supported by cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Tainted Indulgence to set up the combo. The deck also includes cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push for disruption, as well as Prismari Command for versatility. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures while controlling the game with disruptive spells.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on efficiently controlling the board with countermagic and removal spells while deploying threats that can quickly close out games. With a mix of disruptive spells like Counterspell and Lightning Bolt, along with versatile threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent, this deck aims to pressure the opponent while keeping them off balance. The inclusion of Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration helps to smooth out draws and dig for key cards, ensuring that the deck can maintain its aggressive pace throughout the game.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble the equipment combo of Colossus Hammer and Puresteel Paladin or Stoneforge Mystic to create a powerful threat on the battlefield. The deck aims to equip a creature with Colossus Hammer as quickly as possible to deal massive damage to the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Esper Sentinel and Giver of Runes provide additional support and protection for the combo pieces, while cards like Springleaf Drum and Sigarda's Aid help to efficiently equip the Colossus Hammer for maximum impact.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by removing threats, countering spells, and utilizing powerful planeswalkers. It aims to stall the opponent's game plan while generating card advantage and maintaining board control. The deck also includes cards that disrupt opponents' mana bases and minimize their options. The inclusion of Kaheera as a companion provides additional utility and a potential alternate win condition. Overall, the strategy revolves around outlasting opponents and overwhelming them with superior card advantage and board presence.

The deck focuses on assembling a toolbox of creatures with various abilities to combo off and generate value. By using cards like Eldritch Evolution and Chord of Calling, the deck can tutor for specific creatures to suit the situation. The key is to utilize creatures like Grist, the Hunger Tide and Yawgmoth, Thran Physician to create powerful synergies and control the board. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a versatile and resilient array of creatures while maintaining a strong presence on the battlefield.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with creatures and using cards like Gravecrawler, Vengevine, and Prized Amalgam to bring them back to the battlefield repeatedly. The key strategy is to use cards that mill your own deck like Hedron Crab and Stitcher's Supplier to trigger this recursion and overwhelm your opponent with a swarm of creatures. Creeping Chill provides additional reach and life gain, while Narcomoeba and Rotting Rats offer additional value when being brought back from the graveyard. Overall, this deck aims to abuse graveyard synergy to create a powerful and aggressive board presence.

The main focus of this deck is to aggressively play powerful threats like Death's Shadow and Dragon's Rage Channeler while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Drown in the Loch. Utilizing cards like Mishra's Bauble and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to generate card advantage and pressure opponents early. The deck aims to close out games quickly by combining efficient threats with disruption and card advantage to overwhelm opponents. The strategy revolves around managing your life total to maximize the power of Death's Shadow and leveraging the strength of the Aggro archetype.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying threats like Dragon's Rage Channeler, Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, and Murktide Regent to pressure the opponent. It includes disruption in the form of Counterspell and Lightning Bolt to control the board and protect its creatures. The deck also utilizes cheap cantrips like Expressive Iteration and Consider to draw through the deck and maintain momentum. Mishra's Bauble provides additional card advantage while cards like Archmage's Charm and Unholy Heat offer versatility in dealing with various threats. The deck aims to close out games quickly and efficiently.

The deck focuses on utilizing the powerful land ramp abilities of Amulet of Vigor in combination with various lands such as Urza's Saga, Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle, and Primeval Titan to quickly assemble the necessary mana for explosive plays. By utilizing lands that provide additional benefits, such as repeatable creature searching or extra combat steps, the deck can generate overwhelming advantage and threaten to win the game in just a few turns. The deck aims to generate an overwhelming board state and overwhelm opponents with a quick and decisive win.

This deck utilizes a combination of creatures with cycling abilities to quickly fill the graveyard and then cast Living End, a powerful sorcery that brings all creatures from the graveyard back into play. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Grief and Force of Negation to control the game and ensure the combo can go off successfully. By cycling through cards and controlling the board, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a sudden flood of creatures, leading to a decisive victory.

The deck focuses on assembling a toolbox of creatures to enable a combo win condition. It utilizes cards like Eldritch Evolution and Chord of Calling to search for specific creatures, such as Grist, the Hunger Tide and Yawgmoth, Thran Physician, to create advantageous board states and ultimately win the game. The deck includes mana dorks like Birds of Paradise and Ignoble Hierarch to ramp into its combo pieces quickly. The combination of sacrificing creatures, generating tokens, and draining life through cards like Blood Artist allows for a versatile and powerful strategy.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with fast, aggressive creatures and spells that deal direct damage. By utilizing low-cost, efficient cards like Lightning Bolt and Monastery Swiftspear, combined with card draw and pump effects like Light Up the Stage and Soul-Scar Mage, the deck aims to maintain momentum and apply consistent pressure. The inclusion of prowess creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler further enhances the deck's ability to deal damage quickly and efficiently, punishing opponents who are unable to keep up with its speed and tempo.
